Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Anna's ability lets her move 2 blood to "any" vampire. Does this mean
the vampire can be controlled, uncontrolled, ready, in torpor-region i.
e. whereever or does the text just miss something?

xcver

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:


Controlled only, (ready or torpored).

Cards need *specific* text to allow them to affect uncontrolled or other
out-of-play cards (ashheap/contested, etc).

--
